description: Find ATProtocol lexicons by what their schemas say: descriptions, definition names, field names and known values. Use it when you don't know the NSID. mode "keyword" (default) matches words; mode "semantic" ranks by meaning, so a plain description of what you need works (e.g. 'store a user's reading list'), and it falls back to keyword when unavailable. By default only lexicons published by their NSID's DNS authority are returned. Returns NSIDs with summaries and AT-URIs; follow up with describe_lexicon.

include_non_authoritative.description: Also return lexicons whose publisher is not the NSID's DNS authority (default false). Such copies may be forks or impersonations.

lexicon_types.description: Only return lexicons whose main definition has one of these types

query.description: What to search for: words, a phrase in quotes, -word to exclude, or (with mode semantic) a plain description. 2 to 256 characters.

name: search_lexicons
